Lena (AE): ACME onboarding POC failing intermittently. Demo tomorrow; they see 401 then 403. Can we triage fast?
ACME SRE: First got 401 Unauthorized, then retry gave 403 with error 'missing_scope:embeddings'. Using same key for generate and embeddings calls.
Diego (Presales): Which endpoints? generate or embeddings? We have separate scope names.
ACME SRE: /v1/generate -> returns 200. /v1/embeddings -> 403. Both use header X-Redwood-Project: acme-project and Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-POC.
Nora (Backend): Sounds like the key is scoped to generate only. If the scope list doesn't include embeddings we'll 403. Can you run keys/introspect?
ACME SRE: Introspect output (sanitized): { kid: a1b2c3, scopes: ["generate"], binding: project=acme-project }
Diego (Presales): Confirms. The onboarding flow issued a generate-only key by default. Quick fixes: (1) request an embeddings-enabled key, (2) use a separate embeddings API key, (3) request combined scope for demo.
Lena (AE): Customer expects a single key for the demo. Can we issue a combined-scope temp key? Also they asked about POC pricing if they go to 1000 tokens/sec.
Ivy (Security): Temp key OK if we limit TTL to 8 hours and restrict to the specific project. Must add audit note. No prod data allowed.
Nora (Backend): I'll generate a combined-scope key with scopes=["generate","embeddings"], TTL=8h, project-binding=acme-project. Creating now.
KeyBot: Issued key sk-temp-2367890123, kid=z9y8x7, scopes=generate,embeddings, binding=project=acme-project, expires=2025-01-10T18:00:00Z
ACME SRE: Re-tried embeddings call with new key -> 200 OK. Thank you.
ACME SRE: Quick note: we saw 401 earlier because client library retries without auth header on preflight when using the internal proxy. Added missing header fixed that flow.
Diego (Presales): Good catch. Also check client timezone when scheduling demos; we had a token TTL mismatch once where client used local timezone and token looked expired.
Lena (AE): About pricing, customer wants POC burst to ~200 reqs/s and long term maybe dedicated. Any ballpark?
Nora (Backend): Trial accounts limited to 50 rps. We can provide a short-term burst add-on (sales ops approval) or Dedicated pool for sustained 200 rps. I'll ping ops with numbers.
Ivy (Security): I'll prepare the security questionnaire answers and include note about temp keys, scope limits, logging, and key rotation.
Diego (Presales): Follow-ups: 1) Nora to DM ops for burst pricing and ETA 2) Ivy to send SQA + SOC2 link 3) Lena to note temp key in CRM and confirm demo time with ACME 4) ACME SRE to validate client retries don't drop auth header.
ACME SRE: We'll validate and confirm. Appreciate the quick turn.
Lena (AE): Updating ACME call: auth fixed, embeddings working, sending security pack and pricing note after ops reply. :thumbsup:
